name: Training and controlling generative models
gist: Papers on how to train models more stably, guide them with preferences, and align their outputs with what users actually want.
explain: Once you've built a generative model, how do you make sure it does what you want? Training stability is one issue: generative models can be finicky to train—they oscillate, they collapse to repetitive outputs, they forget parts of what they learned. Another issue is alignment: the model might learn to generate technically good images according to the training data, but images that are offensive, inaccurate, or unhelpful for the actual use case. A third is control: once trained, how do you steer the model? If you want it to generate images of dogs but not cats, or to emphasize safety, or to match what people actually prefer, how do you do that without retraining?

Training methods here focus on stability: what hyperparameters make training converge smoothly (so the model doesn't oscillate or collapse), which matters because an unstable model never finishes learning or forgets what it learned? How should you structure loss functions—the measures of 'how wrong' the model is—so the model learns efficiently and doesn't waste computation, which is important because training is expensive and poor loss functions waste compute on wrong directions? Should you use adversarial training (where one model generates and another critiques, which forces both to improve), which can work because competition drives both models to perform better? How do you handle class imbalance (when some types of objects are much more common than others in your training data, which can make the model lazy and only generate common things because common things are easier), so the model learns to generate everything it should and doesn't neglect uncommon categories? For alignment and control, researchers use several strategies. Preference learning means showing the model pairs of outputs and asking which is better, then training to match human preferences, so the model learns what humans actually want rather than just what data happens to have. Reinforcement learning from human feedback means scoring model outputs and training to maximize the score, which lets you guide the model toward specific goals by directly rewarding the behaviors you want. Classifier guidance means using a separate model to steer generation—'generate an image that looks like a dog (according to a dog-classifier) and matches the text description,' which works because you can tell the model to follow both the text instruction and the classifier's opinion.

Papers in this area typically propose a new training method (like a better loss function) or a new control mechanism (like a way to steer generation without retraining, which matters because retraining is expensive), test it on standard datasets, and show it improves stability (fewer training failures) or alignment (model outputs match what users want) compared to baselines. The work is often unglamorous—it's engineering and careful experimentation—but critical for making models reliable enough to deploy because a model that sometimes breaks or ignores instructions is not trustworthy.

papers.title: Anomaly-Preference Image Generation
papers.contribution: Outperforms baselines achieving state-of-the-art performance in both realism and diversity via Time-Aware Capacity Allocation and hierarchical sampling.

papers.title: EasyTune: Efficient Step-Aware Fine-Tuning for Diffusion-Based Motion Generation
papers.contribution: EasyTune outperforms DRaFT-50 by 8.91% in alignment improvement while requiring only 31.16% of its additional memory overhead.

papers.title: FAPO: Flawed-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient and Reliable Reasoning
papers.contribution: Improves outcome correctness, process reliability, and training stability across broad domains without increasing token budget.

papers.title: Generate Any Scene: Scene Graph Driven Data Synthesis for Visual Generation Training
papers.contribution: SDv1.5 achieves 4% improvement over baselines via self-improvement, distillation from proprietary models improves SDv1.5 compositional generation by 10% TIFA score on hard concepts, and GRPO fine-tuning surpasses CLIP-based alignment methods.

papers.title: Real-Time Motion-Controllable Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.contribution: AR-Drag achieves high visual fidelity and precise motion alignment with 1.3B parameters, reducing latency significantly compared to state-of-the-art motion-controllable video diffusion models.

papers.title: TEMPFLOW-GRPO: WHEN TIMING MATTERS FOR GRPO IN FLOW MODELS
papers.contribution: TempFlow-GRPO achieves state-of-the-art human preference alignment in text-to-image generation by capturing temporal structure in flow-based generation.

papers.title: Towards Sequence Modeling Alignment between Tokenizer and Autoregressive Model
papers.contribution: 177M model achieves gFID 1.44 and IS 319.5 on ImageNet-256, scaling to 662M reaches gFID 1.28 surpassing SOTA diffusion at 10x faster sampling.

papers.title: What matters for Representation Alignment: Global Information or Spatial Structure?
papers.contribution: iREPA consistently improves REPA convergence speed across diverse encoders and model sizes with a 4-line modification, demonstrating spatial information transfer is critical for generation.

papers.title: $f$-Trajectory Balance: A Loss Family for Tuning GFlowNets, Generative Models, and LLMs with Off- and On-Policy Data
papers.contribution: Applies f-trajectory balance to GFlowNets, generative models, and LLM tuning, showing models retain predicted properties and can adapt to off-policy data.

papers.title: ATGen: Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Test Case Generation
papers.contribution: Improves IO Accuracy by nearly 40 absolute points (71.56% vs. 31.83%) and more than doubles Attack Rate (34.02% vs. 16.24%) over SFT-based UTGen.

papers.title: Adversarial Flow Models
papers.contribution: Achieves FID of 2.38 with B/2 model at 1NFE on ImageNet-256px, and 1.94 with 112-layer model surpassing 4NFE counterparts with equal compute.

papers.title: Alleviating Sparse Rewards by Modeling Step-Wise and Long-Term Sampling Effects in Flow-Based GRPO
papers.contribution: TP-GRPO alleviates reward sparsity and consistently improves text-to-image generation by exploiting reward signals more effectively with hyperparameter-free turning point detection.

papers.title: AlphaGRPO: Unlocking Self-Reflective Multimodal Generation in Unified Multimodal Models via Decompositional Verifiable Reward
papers.contribution: AlphaGRPO achieves robust improvements across GenEval, TIIF-Bench, DPG-Bench, and WISE benchmarks, plus significant gains on GEdit editing tasks without training on them.

papers.title: Benchmarking and Improving Fine-Grained Text-to-Image Alignment via Paired Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: FocusDiff outperforms prior methods on both DeltaBench and existing benchmarks through learning from paired examples with improved reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Best of Both Worlds: Multimodal Reasoning and Generation via Unified Discrete Flow Matching
papers.contribution: Achieves SOTA across eight benchmarks with strong zero-shot generalization to inpainting, in-context generation, and compositional tasks.

papers.title: Beyond VLM-Based Rewards: Diffusion-Native Latent Reward Modeling
papers.contribution: DiNa-LRM outperforms diffusion-based reward baselines and achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art VLMs while maintaining substantially lower computational cost.

papers.title: Boost the Identity-Preserving Embedding for Consistent Visual Generation
papers.contribution: BIPE outperforms existing methods on ConsiStory+ benchmark and introduces DiverStory benchmark to evaluate consistency across diverse prompt templates.

papers.title: Contrastive Flow Map Matching
papers.contribution: Achieves consistent improvements in fidelity and perceptual quality across CIFAR-10, ImageNet, and LSUN with only modest additional training cost and no inference-time overhead.

papers.title: Diffusion Fine-Tuning via Reparameterized Policy Gradient of the Soft Q-Function
papers.contribution: SQDF achieves superior target rewards while preserving diversity in text-to-image alignment and maintains naturalness and diversity in online black-box optimization.

papers.title: DreamCS: Geometry-Aware Text-to-3D Generation with Unpaired 3D Reward Supervision
papers.contribution: DreamCS outperforms prior methods by producing 3D assets that are both geometrically faithful and human-preferred through direct training on unpaired 3D data.

papers.title: Dual-IPO: Dual-Iterative Preference Optimization for Text-to-Video Generation
papers.contribution: Dual-IPO consistently improves video generation quality across model architectures and sizes, enabling a 2B model to surpass a 5B baseline.

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Post-Training Mitigates Reward Hacking in Live Human-AI Music Interaction
papers.contribution: The method improves output diversity, harmonic coherence, adaptation speed and user agency in real-time interactive melody-to-chord accompaniment, validated through simulation and user studies with expert musicians.

papers.title: GoT-R1: Unleashing Reasoning Capability of Autoregressive Visual Generation with Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves significant improvements on T2I-CompBench and GenEval, particularly on compositional tasks with precise spatial relationships.

papers.title: Graph-GRPO: Training Graph Flow Models with Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves 95.0% and 97.5% Valid-Unique-Novelty scores on planar and tree datasets with only 50 denoising steps, and state-of-the-art performance on molecular optimization tasks.

papers.title: Group Critical-token Policy Optimization for Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.contribution: By leveraging only 30% of image tokens, GCPO achieves better performance than GRPO with full tokens on multiple benchmarks.

papers.title: How to Guide Your Flow: Few-Step Alignment via Flow Map Reward Guidance
papers.contribution: Matches or surpasses baselines with as few as 3 NFEs, giving at least order-of-magnitude speedup over prior state-of-the-art in guidance.

papers.title: Implicit Inversion turns CLIP into a Decoder
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that CLIP alone (frozen) can perform text-to-image generation, style transfer, and image reconstruction without pre-trained decoders.

papers.title: Implicit Preference Alignment for Human Image Animation
papers.contribution: Achieves effective preference optimization for hand generation quality while significantly lowering data curation barrier.

papers.title: LeakGFN: Robust Molecular Generation in Generative Flow Networks via Flow Decomposition
papers.contribution: Proves LeakGFN recovers correct distribution over accessible molecules under mild assumptions; achieves sota on 4 of 5 molecular optimization tasks with plug-and-play integration into existing frameworks.

papers.title: MOSAIC: Multi-Subject Personalized Generation via Correspondence-Aware Alignment and Disentanglement
papers.contribution: Achieves SOTA performance on multi-subject generation while maintaining fidelity beyond 3 subjects where existing methods degrade.

papers.title: Motion-R1: Enhancing Motion Generation with Decomposed Chain-of-Thought and RL Binding
papers.contribution: Motion-R1 achieves 3.5% improvement in MM-Dist on HumanML3D and improvements in R-Precision and FID on other benchmarks.

papers.title: PCPO: Proportionate Credit Policy Optimization for Preference Alignment of Image Generation Models
papers.contribution: Substantially outperforms DanceGRPO with faster convergence and superior image quality through mitigating recursive training failures.

papers.title: Preference-Calibrated Optimization with Score-Level Distribution Alignment for Text-to-Image Diffusion Model Unlearning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art erasure efficacy for object, style, and NSFW unlearning while maintaining superior model utility.

papers.title: ReTabSyn: Realistic Tabular Data Synthesis via Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across benchmarks with small sample sizes, class imbalance, and distribution shift.

papers.title: Reconstruction Alignment Improves Unified Multimodal Models
papers.contribution: Consistently improves generation and editing fidelity across autoregressive, masked-autoregressive, and diffusion-based UMMs with only 27 GPU-hours and strong performance on GenEval and DPGBench.

papers.title: SONA: Learning Conditional, Unconditional, and Matching-Aware Discriminator
papers.contribution: SONA achieves superior sample quality and conditional alignment compared to state-of-the-art methods on class-conditional generation and text-to-image tasks.

papers.title: StructMAR: Structure-Aware Masked Autoregression for Explicit Layout Alignment in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves 57.2 AP on COCO-Position and 79.4 mIoU, 61.7 ISR on COCO-MIG with 4.05x inference speedup.

papers.title: TAGRPO: Boosting GRPO on Image-to-Video Generation with Direct Trajectory Alignment
papers.contribution: Achieves significant improvements over DanceGRPO in image-to-video generation through direct trajectory alignment with high-reward samples and a memory bank for rollout diversity.

papers.title: Think-Then-Generate: Reasoning-Aware Text-to-Image Diffusion with LLM Encoders
papers.contribution: T2G achieves 0.79 on WISE score for reasoning-based image generation and editing, nearly on par with GPT-4.

papers.title: Threshold-Guided Optimization for Visual Generative Models
papers.contribution: Consistently improves preference alignment across diffusion and masked generative models on multiple test sets and reward models; enables alignment from unpaired scalar feedback.

papers.title: VAnim: Rendering-Aware Sparse State Modeling for Structure-Preserving Vector Animation
papers.contribution: First LLM-based framework for text-to-SVG animation compresses sequence length by 9.8× while guaranteeing topological isomorphism.

papers.title: World-R1: Reinforcing 3D Constraints for Text-to-Video Generation
papers.contribution: The approach significantly enhances 3D consistency in generated videos while preserving visual quality of the foundation model, bridging video generation and scalable world simulation.

papers.title: iGRPO: Fast Online RL for Flow Matching Model with Instant Reward
papers.contribution: Converges 10.2× faster than FlowGRPO while achieving higher final alignment quality across standard benchmarks.
